title: A Life Painted in Self-Portraits
paragraphs: Frida Kahlo was born in Mexico City in 1907, in a house that is now a museum dedicated to her life, and she always came back to it. As a child she survived polio, which left one leg shorter than the other. At eighteen, she was badly injured when the bus she was riding in collided with a streetcar. During the long months she spent in bed, she began to paint, using a mirror placed above her so that she could study her own face.

Her self-portraits are among the most outstanding parts of her work, and their style was influenced by the portrait photography she learned from her father. In her clothing and her paintings alike, she tried to reclaim the roots of Mexican folk art. She explained that she painted self-portraits because she was often alone and because she was the person she knew best. She married the muralist Diego Rivera in 1929, divorced him in 1939 and remarried him a year later. Some people thought she was a surrealist, but she rejected the term and said she painted her own reality, not dreams.

She died in 1954, and in 1958 her family home was opened to the public as the Frida Kahlo Museum, now one of the most popular museums in the Mexican capital. The museum describes her as a reference that goes beyond the myth she created around herself. Inside the house, her crutches, corsets and medicines still show the physical suffering and many operations she endured.

sources.claim: Frida Kahlo 6 Temmuz 1907'de Mexico City'de, ailesinin bugün Mavi Ev (Casa Azul) olarak bilinen evinde doğdu; altı yaşında çocuk felci geçirdi ve bir bacağı diğerinden kısa kaldı.
sources.source: Museo Frida Kahlo, Biography of Frida Kahlo (resmi PDF, 2020); https://www.museofridakahlo.org.mx/wp/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Biografias-Frida-Kahlo-ingles.pdf

sources.claim: 18 yaşında, 17 Eylül 1925'te bindiği otobüse bir tramvay çarptı; aylarca hareketsiz kaldığı dönemde resim yapmaya başladı.
sources.source: Museo Frida Kahlo, Biography of Frida Kahlo (resmi PDF, 2020); https://www.museofridakahlo.org.mx/wp/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Biografias-Frida-Kahlo-ingles.pdf

sources.claim: Mavi Ev, Kahlo'nun doğduğu ve öldüğü yerdir; evlendikten sonra başka yerlerde yaşasa da hep aile evine döndü. Ev 1958'de, ölümünden dört yıl sonra müze yapıldı ve bugün Meksika başkentinin en popüler müzelerinden biridir.
sources.source: Museo Frida Kahlo, The Blue House: Frida Kahlo's Intimate Universe (resmi PDF); https://www.museofridakahlo.org.mx/wp/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/The-Blue-House.pdf

sources.claim: Ev müzesinde aynalı yatak (kazadan sonra annesi kurmuştur), koltuk değnekleri, korseler ve ilaçlar sergilenir; bunlar fiziksel acılarına ve geçirdiği çok sayıda ameliyata tanıklık eder.
sources.source: Museo Frida Kahlo, The Blue House: Frida Kahlo's Intimate Universe (resmi PDF); https://www.museofridakahlo.org.mx/wp/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/The-Blue-House.pdf

sources.claim: Otoportreleri, babasından öğrendiği fotoğraf portreciliğinden etkilenmiştir; giyiminde ve yaşamında Meksika halk sanatının köklerini yeniden sahiplenmeye çalıştı.
sources.source: Museo Frida Kahlo, Biography of Frida Kahlo (resmi PDF, 2020); https://www.museofridakahlo.org.mx/wp/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Biografias-Frida-Kahlo-ingles.pdf

sources.claim: 1929'da Diego Rivera ile evlendi, 1939'da boşandı, bir yıl sonra yeniden evlendi.
